item.title: The Democratic Party gained power across the country in the midterms. Now what?
item.description: Voters handed Democrats the keys to power across the country and expect them to drive in a different direction. Party leaders are now trying to figure out which way to go.
item.content:encoded:
Voters handed Democrats the keys to power across the country and expect them to drive in a different direction. Party leaders are now trying to figure out which way to go.

item.title: California voters defeat billionaire tax proposal that divided Democrats
item.description: The novel proposal would have charged billionaires a one-time 5% tax on most of their overall wealth, including their ownership in companies.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Supreme Court says border wall construction can continue in west Texas
item.description: The Trump administration filed an emergency relief request with the high court earlier in October asking for the construction to continue while a lawsuit over the plan moves forward.

item.title: Democrats won big. Can they lower your grocery bill?
item.description: Affordability concerns were top of mind for voters heading into the midterms, as tariffs and the war in Iran drove up prices, including food costs. Now, Americans are expecting relief from Washington.
